title: TNTChat
description: Get notified when players place TNT or TNT minecarts — directly in chat, console, and logs.
body:
# 💣 TNTChat

TNTChat is a lightweight Spigot/Paper plugin that alerts you when players place **TNT** or **TNT minecarts**.  
It shows messages instantly in chat and console, saves them into log files, and even lets you view today’s TNT activity in-game.

## ✨ Features
- Notifications in chat, console, and log files  
- Daily logs stored at: `plugins/TntChat/logs/tnt-events-<date>.log`  
- Command **`/tntinfo`** – shows all TNT events of the current day directly in-game  
- Fully translatable via `texts.yml`  
- No configuration needed  
- Lightweight and fast  

## 📥 Installation
- Download the `.jar`  
- Drop it into your `plugins/` folder  
- Restart your server  

## 🌍 Translations
All messages are stored in `plugins/TntChat/texts.yml`.  
Edit this file to translate the plugin into your language.  

## ⚙️ Compatibility
- Works on Spigot & Paper (1.21 – 1.21.8)  
- No dependencies
